name: NeRF Training Configuration
aliases: NeRF Training Configuration — NeRF Training Loop Configuration, NeRF Training Setup, Sparsity Prior, Sparsity Regularization
definition: A regularization term added to the NeRF training loss to encourage the model to choose empty space in unobserved regions, preventing arbitrary geometry generation that would degrade the spatial resolution of the subsequent octree conversion.
summary: NeRF Training Configuration uses a sparsity prior to prevent non-photorealistic geometry in unobserved regions, distinguishing it from methods like Mip-NeRF by ensuring suitability for sparse octree representations.
